title.narrative: Apoyo a la Reconfiguracin del Sector Educativo en Hait
Support for Haiti's Reconfiguration of the Education Sector

description.narrative: El objetivo general del proyecto son para apoyar el programa del Gobierno para reestructurar el sector de la educacin y desarrollar una mano de obra calificada en la prxima dcada. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) proporcionar la infraestructura educativa de calidad; (ii) Proporcionar material escolar; (iii) ampliar el acceso a la educacin bsica a travs de subvenciones a escuelas privadas; y (iv) fortalecer la capacidad institucional para administra el sector.

The overall project objectives are to support the government's program to restructure the education sector and develop a skilled labor pool over the next decade. The specific objectives are: (i) provide quality educational infrastructure; (ii) provide school materials; (iii) expand access to basic education through grants to non-public schools; and (iv) strengthen the institutional capacity to manage the sector.
